info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of a Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk, allowing organizations to efficiently manage their trading operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and trading firms that aim to streamline their dealer desk functionality. The primary resource is the dealer desk, which serves as a centralized hub for executing trades and managing trading strategies. By utilizing this API, businesses can automate the setup process and enhance their trading capabilities.

post.summary: Create a new dealer desk trade.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new trade entry at the dealer desk within the wholesale trading platform. You can specify details such as trade type, quantity, and price. Ensure that all required information is included in the request body for successful trade creation.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a dealer desk operation in wholesale trading. This body must conform to the defined schema and contain all necessary information for processing the request.
